goals.title: Achieve zero silent failures — every cron run is visible and verified
goals.why: Silent failures are the worst kind. If a cron fails and nobody knows, the system is lying about its health.
goals.progress: Health JSONL writer running. Some crons still failing silently due to path issues (TICKET-20260224-013).
goals.nextAction: Fix relative path issues in cron monitors. Verify health.jsonl is updating every 15 min.

goals.title: Make A2A delegation log the source of truth for team activity
goals.why: If a2a-delegations.jsonl is populated and accurate, Anurag can see the team working without asking anyone.
goals.progress: Log file exists but empty. SOUL.md now mandates logging. Need to verify compliance.
goals.nextAction: Monitor a2a-delegations.jsonl daily. Alert RED if empty by 6pm.

goals.title: Close all P2 tickets within SLA
goals.why: P2 tickets at 8h SLA. If they're open longer, the system is not self-healing.
goals.progress: Multiple open tickets. Need to triage and assign.
goals.nextAction: Read TICKET-TRACKER.md, identify all P2 tickets past SLA, escalate or fix.
